description: This Java class models a shopping cart entity within an e-commerce system. It manages the shopping cart's properties, such as a unique identifier, code, items, associated merchant store, customer ID, and audit information. It uses JPA/Hibernate annotations for ORM mapping to a database.

classes.name: ShoppingCart
classes.description: Entity representing a shopping cart with details like items, merchant store, customer info, and auditing.

methods.name: getAuditSection
methods.description: Returns the audit information associated with this shopping cart.

methods.name: setAuditSection
methods.description: Sets the audit information for this shopping cart.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Retrieves the unique identifier of this shopping cart.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of this shopping cart.

methods.name: isObsolete
methods.description: Checks whether the shopping cart is obsolete.

methods.name: setObsolete
methods.description: Marks the shopping cart as obsolete or active.

methods.name: getLineItems
methods.description: Retrieves the set of items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: setLineItems
methods.description: Sets the items in the shopping cart.

methods.name: getShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Returns the unique code identifying the shopping cart.

methods.name: setShoppingCartCode
methods.description: Assigns a unique code to the shopping cart.

methods.name: getCustomerId
methods.description: Retrieves the customer ID associated with the cart.

methods.name: setCustomerId
methods.description: Sets the customer ID for the shopping cart.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Returns the merchant store associated with this cart.

methods.name: setMerchantStore
methods.description: Sets the merchant store associated with this cart.
